name: Jean-Pierre Stanley
original_name: ジャン＝ピエール・スタンレー
source:
Episode: Tsuki ni Yorisou Otome no Sahou 0

A young genius who will be named as a global fashion designer in a few year. His mother is a French and he grew up in Paris. Aeon's childhood friend, the only one he called his "best friend".
